quests.title: two in the afternoon at Ourimbah
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I start at two in the afternoon and for a month the Ourimbah back lane has had somebody in it who is not waiting for bread. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: the lane, from the door, no flash
I am not calling anyone until I am sure

quests.title: The Lane Light, Ourimbah
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. A light on that lane costs Ourimbah $51 and the landlord has said no twice, so we are doing it ourselves. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: $51 and I will fit it myself
do not tell him where it came from

quests.title: Flour Run, Ourimbah
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The flour for Ourimbah comes off a truck at two in the afternoon and last a Tuesday the truck came and the flour did not. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: ride out to Lisarow where the load is made up
the pallet with our name on it, if it exists

quests.title: The Loading Zone, Ourimbah
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. The Ourimbah loading zone has had a car in it at two in the afternoon every morning this week and the driver waits in it, which makes it worse. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the one who says he is only a minute
and the ticket I got, off him

quests.title: The Sourdough Sign, Ourimbah
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Somebody two doors down from Ourimbah put up a sign on a Tuesday that says the same six words as ours, in the same order. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: walk down and read it properly
both signs if you can get them in one frame
tell me I am not imagining it

quests.title: The Old Site, Ourimbah
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. This business was at Lisarow before it was at Ourimbah, and there is a woman there who still has the original book. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: she is usually about in the afternoon
bring back whatever she is willing to say

quests.title: The Granville Pool
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Council has been saying the Granville pool is at end of life since grand final week and the crack they keep pointing at is not in the shell. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: the crack, close, with something for scale
an engineer can read that. A councillor cannot.

quests.title: The Petition Stall, Granville
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. We are running a stall for Granville on grand final week and a stall needs $49 of gear that nobody has volunteered to pay for. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: $49 and a table, if you see one
I will be there from eight either way

quests.title: Squad, Granville
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. I coach 23 kids at Granville at first light and three of them have stopped coming without anybody ringing me. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the flats where two of them live
take something with you, it is a long walk up
I do not need them back. I need to know.

quests.title: The Deep End, Granville
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. A group has been coming over the Granville fence after close and swimming in the dark, which is how Granville loses its pool. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the ones who go over the fence
the spot in the fence they use

quests.title: The Kiosk Freezer, Granville
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. The kiosk at Granville has a clipboard nobody signs in it and a freezer that has been running warm since grand final week. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: get two, we are going to be here
the plant room behind the kiosk
tell me whether it is the freezer or the power

quests.title: The Aquatic Centre, Granville
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. They want everyone from Granville to drive to the new centre at Harris Park, so somebody should go and see whether it is any good. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: have a proper look, not a quick one
be honest with me, even if it is nice

quests.title: The Mount Colah Rank
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The rank outside Mount Colah used to hold nine cars and since the first of the month it holds four, and nobody will say who moved the line. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: the painted line and the old one under it
the old paint is still there, that is the whole argument

quests.title: Lost Fares, Mount Colah
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Since the rank at Mount Colah shrank I am $62 a week down, and the association wants that number from somebody who can prove it. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: $62 in a week, to show it can be done
that is the submission, right there

quests.title: Queue Jumpers, Mount Colah
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. Cars that have never sat in the Mount Colah queue turn up at first light and take the front of it, and the drivers who waited say nothing. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the ones who take the front
$82, which is about one airport run

quests.title: The Late Train, Mount Colah
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. When the last train into Mount Colah is late, 82 people come out at once and I have to have cars there before they do. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: come in on the last one from Asquith and see it
the rank at the moment the doors open

quests.title: The Door, Mount Colah
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. I have stood on this door near Mount Colah for 82 years and since the first of the month somebody has been sending my guests to a different rank. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: follow one of them and see where they end up
you will be standing about, get something

quests.title: The Depot, Mount Colah
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. The plates working the Mount Colah rank are dispatched from a depot at Asquith, and the man who runs it has never met a driver he liked. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: go and be pleasant at him anyway
tell me whether he is the problem or the symptom
